name: Maimonides completes the Guide for the Perplexed
summary: Moses Maimonides (Rambam), court physician to Saladin's vizier in Cairo, completes Dalalat al-Ha'irin ('Guide for the Perplexed'), a rationalist synthesis of Aristotelian philosophy and rabbinic Judaism addressed to readers troubled by the apparent conflict between philosophy and revelation.

_quarry.structural_significance: Defining medieval Jewish philosophical work; later influences Aquinas, Spinoza, and the broader scholastic-rationalist tradition.
